title: WaXup: Weight Averaging of Experts as Data Augmentation for Robust Introspection
abstract: arXiv:2611.27353v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As the capabilities of large language models keep improving, traditional mechanistic interpretability methods struggle to keep pace. In contrast, trainable introspection methods emerge as a promising alternative; they repurpose the model itself as a self-diagnostic tool, trained to verbalize what it has learned during finetuning in natural language. While training on datasets of finetuned experts achieves encouraging results, it currently lacks robustness and generalization. Building on the data augmentation framework of MiXup, we introduce WaXup, a method that augments the introspection training set through linear interpolation in the weight space. This is motivated by the linear mode connectivity property: weight averaged experts interpolate the behaviors of the initial experts. We evaluate WaXup on three benchmarks: hidden-behavior models, a meta-dataset of real-world NLP tasks and AuditBench, a challenging alignment auditing suite

translated_title: WaXup：专家模型权重平均作为数据增强以实现鲁棒的内省
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型能力的不断提升，传统的机制可解释性方法难以跟上其发展步伐。相比之下，可训练的内省方法作为一种有前景的替代方案应运而生；它将模型本身重新用作自我诊断工具，通过训练使模型能够用自然语言表达其在微调过程中学到的内容。虽然在微调专家模型的数据集上进行训练取得了令人鼓舞的结果，但目前这种方法缺乏鲁棒性和泛化能力。基于MiXup的数据增强框架，我们提出了WaXup，这是一种通过权重空间中的线性插值来增强内省训练集的方法。这一方法的理论依据是线性模式连通性特性：权重平均后的专家模型能够插值初始专家模型的行为。我们在三个基准上评估了WaXup：隐藏行为模型、真实世界NLP任务的元数据集，以及AuditBench——一个具有挑战性的对齐审计套件。
tldr: 本文提出WaXup方法，通过在权重空间中对专家模型进行线性插值（权重平均）来增强内省训练数据，从而显著提升大模型可训练内省方法的鲁棒性与泛化能力。
en_tdlr: We introduce WaXup, a method that augments introspection training data via weight-averaging (linear interpolation in weight space) of experts, improving the robustness and generalization of trainable introspection for LLMs.
